note: Law registry for ship_door.py. Fail-closed: an applicable law with gate:null BLOCKS. hard:true laws are never disarmed by the bypass file. Replace or extend these with your organisation's own publishing rules; every law needs an executable gate or it blocks.

laws.rule: An AI-generated human may never portray a named real person. Keyed on an explicit list (content.names_portrayed_by_ai_humans), not on a boolean that can be argued either way.
AI-generated content must carry the platform-required AI disclosure.
Third-party music, footage or images ship only with cleared rights.
Content making factual claims ships only after a review pass.
Any on-screen text is proofread at the target surface's real scale (a caption that reads fine at 4K can be garbled at 1080p vertical).
No credential, token or private key may leave the building inside a published file.
Example of a wired external gate: a video must be within the surface's duration limits (script provided in gates/).
